# Spells Encyclopedia

## Spell Schools

| School | Focus | Counter |
|--------|-------|---------|
| Abjuration | Protection | dispel magic |
| Conjuration | Summoning | dispel magic |
| Divination | Information | anti-divination |
| Enchantment | Control | saves |
| Evocation | Damage | saves |
| Illusion | Deception | investigation |
| Necromancy | Death | dispel magic |
| Transmutation | Change | dispel magic |

## Spell Casting

### Components

- Verbal (V) - spoken words
- Somatic (S) - hand gestures
- Material (M) - specific items

### Concentration

- Max 1 concentration spell at a time
- Breaking concentration ends spell
- Taking damage may break (CON save)

### Ritual Casting

- Adds 10 minutes to casting time
- No spell slot required
- Must have ritual tag
